notes.title: Free To Play
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that starting March 1, 2025, our game will officially become free to play! 🎉

This was the first game we ever developed, marking the beginning of our journey. We want to make it available to everyone and share our work with more people.

Thank you to those who supported us early on—it means the world to us.

notes.title: Join Our New Telegram Channel for Game Updates, News and Feedback
notes.notes:
https://t.me/TraviTeamGamesOfficial

We are excited to announce the launch of our new Telegram channel where you can get the latest news and updates about our games, as well as direct access to us to share your feedback and ideas.

Our Telegram channel is the perfect place to stay informed about upcoming game releases, new features, and exciting developments in the gaming world. We will be sharing exclusive sneak peeks, behind-the-scenes insights, and other content that you won't find anywhere else.

But that's not all. We want to hear from you too! We believe that your feedback is critical to making our games even better, which is why we've created a space where you can share your thoughts and suggestions directly with our team. Whether you have a bug to report, a feature request, or just want to say hello, we're always happy to hear from you.

So if you're a fan of our games and want to stay connected with us, be sure to join our new Telegram channel today. We can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: New Music Tracks Added!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that we have added new music tracks to Scroter!

You'll find an array of electronic beats and synth-heavy soundscapes that will have you completely engrossed in the gameplay.

Whether you're dodging obstacles, collecting power-ups, or just trying to survive, the new tracks will make it all the more exciting!

We'd love to hear your feedback. Let us know what you think of the new music, and don't forget to share your high scores with us on social media!

Traviteam
